tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find published TicketGlide city, attraction and day-trip guides. Searches editorial metadata, not supplier inventory.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Read a published guide path from search_guides, including source links and factual check dates when present. No drafts or supplier reviews. TicketGlide MCP documentation: https://ticketglide.com/mcp.

tools.name: create_search_link
tools.description: Build a TicketGlide website search URL. Destination is a supported destination ID/name or worldwide. Categories include all, attractions, tours and day-trips. This does not execute a search or check availability.
